el_to_en.Από το 2008 αναδεικνύουμε την ελληνική ξ: Since 2008, we have brought out the qualities of Greek timber through original furniture. Designers and craftspeople work together on indoor and outdoor constructions with a distinct aesthetic and practical purpose.

For residences, hotels and professional spaces, we combine wood, marble, stone, glass and metal with equal attention to function and aesthetics.
el_to_en.Κατασκευές μέσα και έξω από το κτίριο: σ: Construction inside and outside the building: staircases, windows, doors, pergolas, cladding and floors, adapted to the needs of each project.
el_to_en.Κουζίνες, ντουλάπες και έπιπλα κατά παρα: Bespoke kitchens, wardrobes and furniture. Traditional and contemporary materials come together in solutions shaped around a space and the people who use it.
el_to_en.Στη Βάρη, σε έκθεση 1.100 τ.μ., και στου: At our 1,100 sq m showroom in Vari and our two spaces in Kolonaki, we explore your project's possibilities together. Production and distribution are based in Kouvaras.
el_to_en.Νέα έργα, άνθρωποι και ιδέες γύρω από το: New projects, people and ideas around wood. Developments at Domogroup, our exhibitions and the stories we share.
el_to_en.Οκτώ δεκαετίες εξέλιξης στο ξύλο και το: Eight decades of working with wood, and the next chapter for the Greek company.
el_to_en.Το αφιέρωμα του NouPou ακολουθεί τη διαδ: The NouPou feature follows the journey from Efthymis Chalkidis' woodworking shop in Katerini to today's Domogroup. The company marks its eightieth anniversary in 2027.
el_to_en.Οι ανανεωμένες εκθέσεις επιτρέπουν στον: The renewed showrooms let visitors discover the materials and discuss complete proposals. In Vari, a 1,100 sq m space brings Living and Contract applications together.

el_to_en.Ο σχεδιασμός, η ποιότητα, η κομψότητα κα: Design, quality, elegance and everyday function are treated as parts of the same approach. Visit the team in Kolonaki to discuss your ideas and shape a solution that fits your space.

el_to_en.Η παρουσία της Domogroup στη Xenia 2025: Domogroup's presence at Xenia 2025 highlighted its work in professional equipment and complete applications for hospitality spaces. The stand presented products and constructions designed around the needs of hotels and food-service businesses.
el_to_en.Οι επισκέπτες γνώρισαν εφαρμογές για ξύλ: Visitors discovered applications for wooden windows, pergolas and bespoke construction. The presentation connected design with durability, function and technology, with quality at the heart of the proposals.
el_to_en.Ξεχωριστή θέση είχαν η βιωσιμότητα και η: Sustainability and energy efficiency had a distinct place. The company sees them as essential considerations in the development of tourism and contemporary hotel projects.
el_to_en.Η ομάδα υποδέχθηκε επαγγελματίες από δια: The team welcomed professionals from across Greece to discuss new trends, exchange ideas and explore proposals adapted to the requirements of individual projects.
el_to_en.Η έκθεση λειτούργησε τόσο ως παρουσίαση: The exhibition served as both a presentation of applications and a place for communication and new partnerships. Investment in expertise, understanding clients and Greek hospitality continues to guide Domogroup's next steps.
el_to_en.Επιτέλους υπάρχουν ακόμα άνθρωποι που βά: At last, there are still people who put care and quality above everything, especially when everyone wants everything quickly. I have never felt more satisfied with money I have spent. Quality always comes before quantity.
el_to_en.Καταρτισμένο, πρόθυμο και ευγενικό προσω: Knowledgeable, helpful and courteous staff. They work to find practical and beautiful solutions within the customer’s budget.
el_to_en.Εξαιρετικά προϊόντα και εξαιρετικό servi: Excellent products and outstanding service. The finished result exceeded our expectations, the company met its deadlines, and everyone we dealt with showed responsibility and professionalism.
el_to_en.Καταπληκτική ποιότητα ξύλινων επίπλων! Ε: Amazing quality of wooden furniture! Exceptional designs. I bought a dining table and its just awesome! All good!
el_to_en.Είχα την τύχη να φτιάξω τις εσώπορτες το: I had the interior doors for my home made by Domogroup and was very pleased. The team offered impeccable service and answered every question. The result was excellent: great quality at good prices, with professionals who delivered everything we agreed.
el_to_en.Υπέροχη δουλειά! εξυπηρέτηση και συνεργα: Wonderful work, service and collaboration, just as you would expect from someone who knows their craft. Shared decisions and excellent suggestions. A simple “well done” is not enough!

en_to_el.At last, there are still people who put: Επιτέλους υπάρχουν ακόμα άνθρωποι που βάζουν το μεράκι και την ποιότητα πάνω από όλα, ειδικά τώρα σε εποχές που όλοι τα θέλουν όλα γρήγορα. en_to_el.Amazing quality of wooden furniture! Exc: Καταπληκτική ποιότητα ξύλινων επίπλων! Εξαιρετικά σχέδια. Αγόρασα μια τραπεζαρία και είναι απλώς υπέροχη! Όλα τέλεια!
en_to_el.I had the interior doors for my home mad: Είχα την τύχη να φτιάξω τις εσώπορτες του σπιτιού μου στην domogroup και έμεινα πολύ ευχαριστημένη. Ήταν υπέροχες!!!
